summary: Iteration 70 - Verified fixes for overlay usability bugs: scroll and exit functionality. ALL TESTS PASSED. Description panel scrolls correctly on mobile (scrollTop changes from 0 to 300 with scrollHeight=3195, clientHeight=390). Exit button closes overlay immediately (~0.5-0.9s) even while playback is running. Top-right close button also works. Play/pause regression test passed.

test_results.comprehensive_scroll_test: PASS - scrollHeight=3195, clientHeight=390, scrollTop changed from 0 to 300
